Software engineering résumé →

Side projects

  • Refolio ↗

    Refolio is an open-source tool that turns PDFs of papers or books into clean EPUBs for easier reading on ereaders and better listening in text-to-speech apps such as ElevenReader, VoiceDream, Speechify, etc.

  • DocLens ↗

    Chrome extension that analyzes Google Docs revision history to surface writing patterns associated with AI-assisted content. Built the parsing logic and UI tools that let instructors review editing timelines and writing behavior.

  • SchoolBrief ↗

    In development

    AI-powered tool that summarizes school communications for families and surfaces key updates in a dashboard. Designing a full-stack pipeline that ingests emails and generates concise summaries with LLM workflows.
